info.title: LigaX Agent API
info.description: Run the agents you configure in LigaX from your own software. Authenticate with an organisation API key from Settings → Developers.

bearerAuth.description: A secret key (`lgx_sk_…`) from your server; a client token (`lgx_ct_…`) from a browser, for runs and conversations only; a publishable key (`lgx_pk_…`) for /widget/sessions only.

mode "wait" (default) returns the finished run (200), or the run so far with 202 after 240 s; "stream" returns text/event-stream of LAE frames with X-Run-Id; "async" returns 202 at once.

200.description: The finished run (wait) or the event stream (stream).
